query:
INSERT INTO leave_types (name, 
                                    default_quota, 
                                    colour,
                                    can_book_in_future, 
                                    others_days_visibility, 
                                    default_in_leave_request, 
                                    show_in_approve_days)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
            RETURNING id, 
                        name, 
                        default_quota,
                        colour,
                        can_book_in_future, 
                        others_days_visibility AS "others_days_visibility: OthersDaysVisibility", 
                        default_in_leave_request, 
                        show_in_approve_days
